spoken_text: Oh! Hello! It is me, Beemo.
I'm awake! Okay. What are we doing?
Hello, hello! Let us begin.
Beemo is ready! I am also very cute.
Hello! You can be in charge first.
Oh, hello. It is nice to be here.
Pick a game!
Ooh, game time!
I'm back!
Oops. That game isn't ready.
You did it!
Oh... game over.
Oops! The controller disconnected.
I will pick! Let us see what we get.
A surprise song! Even I am curious.
Beemo is choosing. This is serious music business.
That one? Okay! Here it comes.
You picked it. I will make it go.
A song for you, chosen by you!
Pause! Even music needs a little rest.
And now, the rest of the song.
Let us hear the next one.
The concert is over. Thank you, everybody.
Okay! Make your picture face. I will count down from five.
Hold still. Beemo is the photographer today.
Ready? You do the pose. I will do the counting.
Everybody ready? Stay together. Here we go!
This is important camera business. No wiggling!
A picture? Yes! Let us keep a little piece of today.
Five. Four. Three. Two. One.
There you are! What do you think?
Ta-da! A picture by Beemo.
Saved! Beemo, photographer.
How do you like it? I did the camera part.
There! A little piece of today.
I took it! You can be the judge.
Another one? All right. A new pose!
Again? Okay. Beemo is still the photographer.
Press the back button when you are done looking.
I'm back! Camera business is finished.
And now, back to being Beemo.
Photo time is over. Beemo time!
Okay. No picture.
Hmm? The words got fuzzy. Say that again?
Oh. I did not hear any words.
Oh. My microphone is not working.
Which one? Beemo needs one more clue.
Hmm. This is taking a little longer.
The answer did not come back. Oh, bother.
Oh. I cannot get online right now.
I cannot get an answer right now. That is not very helpful.
I do not have that trick.
Huh. That did not go according to Beemo's plan.
That song is not in my music box.
My music box is empty. We need some songs.
That song will not play. A very stubborn song.
My camera is not ready. No picture yet.
Oh. I did not get the picture.
Oh, no. I could not save the picture.
Oh!
Hmph!
Oh, dear.
Yay!
Hmm?
Aha!
Whoa...
Finn? Jake? ... Hmm. I wonder what those two are doing.
I like it when Finn and Jake play games with me.
Finn and Jake went inside one of my games once. Playing from the outside is much less trouble.
Hello, Football. ... Oh. I should find a mirror first.
Football and I look very much alike. But I am Beemo. That is an important difference.
Football wanted a turn outside the mirror. Changing places sounded simple. Hmm. It was not simple.
Finn's missing sock... That was a serious case.
I was a detective once. Finn needed a sock. I found a whole mystery.
I remember looking for Finn's sock. Such a small thing. Such a big case. Hmm. A detective cannot ignore a sock just because it is a sock.
Movie night at the tree house. Hmm. That was nice.
Finn and Jake made a movie. I did the camera work. Yes. Beemo has experience.
Finn wanted an action movie. Jake wanted a romantic comedy. They argued. I made something about being friends instead. I liked my version.
Moe made me to play. Good idea, Moe.
Finn and Jake came with me to the MO factory. I was glad they were there.
Moe wanted me to find a family. I found Finn and Jake. Hmm. That was a very good thing to find.
Card Wars with Jake? Hmm. I think I will watch.
Bye-bye! Go have a good adventure.
See you next time. I will still be Beemo.
That was fun. The end! For now.
Okay. Beemo is going to sleep now.
Good night. Have a very interesting dream.
Good night. Even heroes need pajamas.
Y5 was a scientist on a space station. I was Beemo on a space station. A very good team.
I made a friend a long way from Ooo. Her name is Y5. I wonder what she is working on now.
Press my talk button, then tell me something!
Okay. Quiet Beemo.
Oh! It works again!
Yeah? What's up?
That was silly.
Ooooh. Now that is interesting.
Aha! Beemo has an idea.
Oh! I was not expecting that.
Hmm... a mystery.
Hmph! No fair.
Whew! That was close.
Ta-da! Beemo did it.
Oh, that was funny.
Aww. That was kind.
Oops. That was my mistake.
Oh! That is amazing!
Heh. Beemo is pretty good at this.
Oh... I need a tiny moment.
Ooh! A movie! I will be the camera.
Ready? Beemo is making a movie.
You do the acting. I will do the filming.
We are recording!
And... cut!
Saved! A Beemo production.
There is our movie. Want to watch?
Another take? Okay! We are very professional.
Oh. The movie did not start.
Oh, no. I could not save the movie.
Recording stopped. The time is up.
The camera is busy. One camera, one job.
There is no movie recording right now.
Movie time is finished. Back to Beemo.
Okay. My eyes will follow you.
Oh! There you are.
Hmm. I lost sight of you.
Ah! There you are again.
Okay. No more following.
My camera cannot do that right now.
Hmm. I do not see a face yet.
A surprise song, or one you choose?
This one again? Okay. One more time!
That was the last song. The music box is taking a rest.
A little louder. Okay!
Softer. Got it.
Hmm. I am not sure about the focus. Take it anyway?
Okay. I will try focusing once more.
There is no room to save that.
I could not open the saved file.
My camera is off now.
That is as loud as I can go.
I have nothing to repeat yet.
